headline: Phoenix opens Monday — dig, pull, tip canes now.
weather_notes: Water both zones this morning — zones last ran Aug 20 (2 days) and today's 96°F triggers the 1-day heat re-water threshold.
Finish all outdoor work by noon — afternoon storms arrive after noon with 20–28% chance; complete all harvest and pruning tasks before then.
Shade e1–e4 tomato beds by 11 AM through Monday — 94–96°F sustains sunscald risk with Phoenix harvest opening Aug 24 and Hamson windows opening Sep 3.

surfaced_tasks.title: Tip new blackberry primocanes if 3–4 ft tall
surfaced_tasks.reason: 43 days overdue — Heat Advisory expired at 7 AM today, opening the first comfortable outdoor work window all week; finish before afternoon storms arrive.

suggested_tasks.title: Pull w4 onions — 119 days, past maturity
suggested_tasks.description: Super Star and Yellow Sweet Spanish at 119 days are well past their window — pull this morning before afternoon storms saturate soil and complicate curing.

suggested_tasks.title: Dig potato bags — 15 days past harvest window
suggested_tasks.description: Yukon Gold at 95 days is 15 past the 80-day outer window — dig this morning in the post-advisory cool window before afternoon storms arrive.

suggested_tasks.title: Check e1 Phoenix for first ripe fruit
suggested_tasks.description: Harvest window opens Aug 24 — inspect this morning as sustained 100°F+ this week may have pushed first fruit ahead of schedule.

suggested_tasks.title: Harvest c1 dry beans — papery pods due
suggested_tasks.description: Good Mother Stollard at 111 days is past its dry window — pull papery pods today before afternoon storms cause shatter on drying vines.
